---
title: "Core Belief Evidence Log"
description: "Collect specific observations for a fairer view of a recurring belief."
sidebar: tool-finder
page-layout: full
toc: false
execute:
  enabled: false
---

A broad belief can feel certain even when experiences are mixed. Record observations that support, complicate, or leave a new possibility uncertain. Partial examples count as information; confidence ratings are optional and are not proof.

::: {#core-belief-evidence-log-app .skill-app data-mom-app="core-belief-evidence-log"}
Loading Core Belief Evidence Log...
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="An original example"}
Dee is exploring the belief that asking for help always means failure. They note one occasion when a colleague welcomed a specific question, another that was ambiguous, and what they did independently. The log helps them form a more precise view without demanding instant certainty.
:::
